title: Acrylic Blending Techniques for Beginners | Abstract "Moonflower" Tutorial
description:
❣ If you want to blend acrylics like a pro, watch this video➡: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bvtrihe7FNw&t=1302s
In today's tutorial, I’m gonna show you how to blend acrylic paint on canvas like a pro. You will learn blending techniques for beginners and we will also make an abstract acrylic painting “Moonflower” so that you can put it into practice right away. As a bonus, I'll show you how to create a floral texture for our painting. I really hope this is helping you to blend and start diving into acrylic painting. 🖤
